capabilities: Transcribe linked audio and video files to text using Whisper ASR
Add start and end timestamps for each transcribed line
Transcribe multiple files in one batch
Run transcription jobs in the background
Handle many audio and video formats via ffmpeg
extras: The Installation and setup section is empty; the README lists features but no usage instructions.
problem: Obsidian can embed and record audio but offers no speech-to-text, so users must transcribe recordings outside the vault and paste results back in.

relations.evidence: Whisper ASR by Ahmed, for the easy-to-use Whisper webservice backend

summary: Transcription plugin that creates timestamped text transcriptions of audio and video files in Markdown using the Whisper ASR speech-to-text engine.
